title: Insurance Verification Checklist
subtitle: Capture coverage source, member reference, service date, and network status; confirm benefit response and patient notice.
description: Insurance Verification records coverage source, member reference, service date, network status, benefit response, and patient notice. Insurance Verification evidence stays linked.
use_case: Use this insurance verification stage-gated verification when staff must document coverage source and member reference. Reconcile service date, network status, benefit response, and patient notice before the insurance verification handoff. Use the payer response, portal screenshot or call reference, representative name, benefit summary, network response, authorization indicator, patient estimate route, and notice receipt. This administrative record centers payer eligibility, plan dates, network response, benefit limitation, deductible or cost-share source, authorization indicator, representative reference, and patient notice. Ask the assigned insurance verification reviewer to confirm coverage source against the organization's policy.

sections.title: Insurance Verification contact and reference
sections.guidance: Record payer and plan source, member reference, service date, network response, benefit limitation, authorization indicator, call reference, and patient notice.

sections.title: Insurance Verification exception review: checks and corrections
sections.guidance: Check current insurance verification facts at point of use.

blocks.label: Insurance Verification required checks
items: Coverage source is identified for this record
Member reference matches the current request or source
Service date is ready for point-of-use staff
Network status limits or questions are resolved
Benefit response is communicated to the responsible person
Patient notice is confirmed at handoff

blocks.label: Insurance Verification failed or pending items

sections.title: Insurance Verification readiness
sections.guidance: Hold insurance verification readiness on any failed or pending item.
